title: One Website. Three Markets. Why Translation Alone Falls Short.
description: We combine localisation with SEO research and content strategy to help Fintech and Web3 businesses adapt their presence to the markets they’re trying to reach.
coverAlt: VAK Marketing is an advertising agency that has been promoting blockchain and fintech projects.
html:
Your fintech company is expanding into three new markets. The website looks great, the translations are ready, and the marketing team has launched campaigns in each country. 

A few months later, one market is generating leads. The other two? Plenty of visitors, very few inquiries. 

So what went wrong? 

Imagine a payment provider entering Germany, Brazil and the UAE with essentially the same website. 

A German merchant might be looking for information about SEPA payments, card acquiring and settlement conditions. In Brazil, potential customers may want to know whether the provider supports Pix and which local payment methods are available. A business in the UAE could have questions about AED settlement, regulatory requirements and the currencies it can accept. 

All three audiences are researching payment services. They’re just approaching the decision with different priorities. 

Now imagine each visitor lands on a translated version of the same generic page promising “fast, secure and seamless global payments”. 

The language is correct. The information they came looking for is still missing. 

This is where localisation becomes a much bigger job than translation. It involves researching how people search in each market, understanding what competitors offer, adapting service pages and making sure the website accurately explains which products are available in each jurisdiction. 

At VAK Marketing, we combine localisation with SEO research and content strategy to help fintech, iGaming and Web3 businesses adapt their online presence to the markets they’re trying to reach. 

A Brazilian merchant shouldn’t have to dig through a European product page to find out whether Pix is supported. And a German prospect shouldn’t need to contact sales just to understand the provider’s acquiring capabilities. 

If you’re entering a new market, translating the website is a reasonable first step. Just don’t mistake it for a complete market-entry strategy. 

Want to see how we can help your business grow in new markets?   

About VAK Marketing

VAK Marketing is an advertising agency that has been promoting blockchain and fintech projects, crypto tokens, IT startups and Web3 ventures since 2018. The agency works with iGaming operators, platforms, PSPs and affiliate teams, as well as exchanges, wallets, DeFi and infrastructure projects in Web3, and helps founders build personal brands and visible expertise in their markets.

More at https://vakmarketing.com/
